headline: Fox Mandal & Associates advises Rockline Entertainments in M.S. Subbulakshmi biopic
sum: Fox Mandal & Associates has advised Rockline Entertainments on a range of legal and intellectual property matters in connection with its upcoming project based on the life and legacy of the celebrated Indian vocalist and Bharat Ratna…
detail: Fox Mandal & Associates has advised Rockline Entertainments on a range of legal and intellectual property matters in connection with its upcoming project based on the life and legacy of the celebrated Indian vocalist and Bharat Ratna awardee M.S. Subbulakshmi, to be played by actor Rashmika Mandanna. The Firm advised on copyright and allied intellectual property rights and the related legal and contractual considerations. The Firm also assisted in evaluating, securing and structuring the relevant rights and negotiating as well as documenting the associated arrangements.
